purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche K benchmark authored only after r21 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r21.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r21 and was not used to construct r21.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: played action side. asset text fires too?
expectedSourceGroups: Only the printed effect being used applies

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Using the Action effect does not also apply the card's Asset effect.

cases.question: effect says bank it now. costs another action?
expectedSourceGroups: does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A direct bank instruction does not require another Action unless it says so.

cases.question: +1 tactic after reveal. comes in faceup?
expectedSourceGroups: after Tactics are revealed, play it face up

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. An additional Tactic added after the reveal stage is played face up.

cases.question: negated tactic still hits discard?
expectedSourceGroups: a negated Tactic still goes to its owner's Discard Pile during the Aftermath

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, unless another effect gives it a different destination.

cases.question: captured their last territory. win right now?
expectedSourceGroups: immediately runs the Gauntlet and wins

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. A legal capture of the opponent's final Territory wins immediately.

cases.question: financial capacity checked yes, treasury drops later. still 2 actions?
expectedSourceGroups: later Treasury or control changes do not grant or remove the permission that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Once Financial Capacity is established at its check timing, later Treasury changes do not remove that turn's permission.

cases.question: income pushes capital over limit. allowed temporarily?
expectedSourceGroups: Income may temporarily exceed the Capital limit

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Income may temporarily exceed the Capital limit.

cases.question: mission requirement met midbattle. completes automatically?
expectedSourceGroups: Satisfying the requirement does not complete it automatically

semanticCriteria.statement: No. It still requires the Denouement completion Action.

cases.question: special op completion also gives normal mission reward?
expectedSourceGroups: not a normal Mission. It grants no Mission reward

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Special Operations do not grant the normal Mission reward.

cases.question: transmuted card's printed effect goes off too?
expectedSourceGroups: The card is not played and none of its printed effects apply

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A card used for Transmutation is not played and its printed effects do not apply.

cases.question: condemnation sends leftover reserve to grave too?
expectedSourceGroups: Cards remaining in the opponent's Reserve are discarded normally

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Remaining Reserve cards are discarded normally.

cases.question: no martyrs stops their retreat?
expectedSourceGroups: does not prevent harmful consequences, the retreat itself

semanticCriteria.statement: No. No Martyrs does not prevent the retreat itself.

cases.question: conscription immediate bank needs second action?
expectedSourceGroups: immediately play one card from your Hand whose Action effect banks it
does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Conscription directly permits the immediate banking play without a second Action.

cases.question: trade concessions refused. back to hand before gambit?
expectedSourceGroups: Return this card to your Hand before Gambits are set

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. It returns to Hand before Gambits are set.

cases.question: stand ground can block court martial extra retreat but not normal retreat?
expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing card effect would move you

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Stand Ground can ignore Court Martial's extra card-effect movement, but not the normal retreat caused by losing.

cases.question: fieldcraft can ignore quicksand movement cap?
expectedSourceGroups: ignore that effect until the end of the turn
cannot Advance or Fall Back more than one Position

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Fieldcraft can ignore Quicksand's printed Territory movement restriction for the turn.
